name: Voxel Placement in Octree
aliases: Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) insertion with collapse/expand
definition: A recursive function to activate or deactivate a voxel at a specific 3D position within the octree.
summary: Voxel Placement in Octree inserts colored voxils into a Sparse Voxel Octree by recursively handling node expansion and depth limits, differing from Morton-based methods by focusing on raw recursive insertion logic.
